column1: # The typecheck domain: the static checker's own diagnostics.
# 35 of these rows were written in Chinese and carried their English as a value; 78 were written in
# English and carry their Chinese. Both are the same thing to a call site, which is why the columns here
# are named by language rather than by direction: en is what an English reader gets, zh what a Chinese
# reader gets, and the migration moved where the text lives without changing either.
# The call sites are internal/lang/typecheck.go (through (*checker).errf, now errfID) and one in
# internal/lang/eval.go that never reached a localizer at all -- `fmt.Errorf` on its own literal, which
# is why `QK_LANG=zh` printed English for it. That one is this domain's declared ZH fix, proved by name
# id     dotted <domain>.<snake_case>, stable forever, never renumbered, never recycled
# owner  "local": this repository owns the text
# ctx    where the message is raised, for the translator
# note   what kind of message it is, for the translator
# src    the text this repository ships; for a local id the generator requires it to repeat en
